definitions.explanation: An official or formal communication informing someone about something. Can be verbal or written.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}{通知|つうち}が{届|とど}いた。
{変更|へんこう}があれば{通知|つうち}します。
examples.english: We will notify you if there are any changes.

examples.japanese: {スマホ}の{通知|つうち}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I turned off my smartphone notifications.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通知|つうち}する (to notify)
- {通知|つうち}を{受|う}ける (to receive a notice)
- {通知|つうち}{書|しょ} (written notification)
- {合格|ごうかく}{通知|つうち} (acceptance notice)
- {不合格|ふごうかく}{通知|つうち} (rejection notice)
- {事前|じぜん}{通知|つうち} (advance notice)

MODERN USAGE:
- {プッシュ}{通知|つうち} (push notification)
- {通知|つうち}{音|おん} (notification sound)
- {通知|つうち}をオフにする (to turn off notifications)

FORMAL DOCUMENTS:
- {通知|つうち}{状|じょう} / {通知|つうち}{書|しょ} (notification letter)
